To re‑enrol without losing access, open Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication and tap “Reset.” Then scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and enter the six‑digit code it generates to confirm. If you have a recovery code from the original set‑up, you can use that to sign in and reset from there if you can’t reach the settings page. Once re‑enrolled, the old QR code is invalidated and only the new one will work. Let me know if you run into any issues!
